compared_objects.model: MiMo-V2.5-Pro (FP8 block-scale checkpoint, hybrid SWA + GQA attention, 384-expert MoE)
compared_objects.hardware: Azure ND MI300X v5 VM: 8x AMD Instinct MI300X (gfx942, 304 CUs, 192 GB HBM3 each), 8x InfiniBand ports
compared_objects.serving_engine: SGLang (sammysun0711/sglang fork) with AITER, Composable Kernel and FlyDSL kernels
compared_objects.comparison_rule: Every percentage on the reader page compares MI300X with MI300X. No other accelerator is compared.

bringup-20260509.topology: 1 VM, TP8, prefill and decode collocated in one server
bringup-20260509.runtime: SGLang v0.5.11 (e299ec1bf + cherry-picked PR #24652), Triton attention and Triton W8A8 FP8 GEMM, no speculative decoding
bringup-20260509.decode_workload: 16K input / 1K output, random dataset, configured concurrency 32-128
notes: KV capacity was 937K tokens, so concurrency above about 50 queued instead of decoding; output throughput plateaued near 570 tok/s.

stage-20260707-ck.topology: 1P1D: prefill server TP8 on VM A, decode server TP8 on VM B, KV transfer over Mooncake RDMA on 8 IB ports, router and benchmark client on VM A
stage-20260707-ck.server_flags: --tp-size 8 --attention-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --page-size 32 --chunked-prefill-size 32768 --context-length 262144 --max-running-requests 128 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --disable-radix-cache --disable-overlap-schedule --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 --enable-multi-layer-eagle; the prefill server adds --disable-cuda-graph --disaggregation-mode prefill, the decode server --disaggregation-mode decode, both --disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake
stage-20260707-ck.server_env: both servers: SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SGLANG_USE_AITER_CK_BLOCKSCALE_BPRESHUFFLE=1 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected; decode server also SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_VERIFY=1

script_sha256.decode_launch: file hash not captured on the decode VM; its captured environment lines match the 2026-07-13 decode script

runtime.sglang: same container image as stage-20260707-ck (commit not re-captured)

ab-20260718-64k-bs16.topology: 1 VM, TP8, one server doing both prefill and decode (no PD), exact 64K input token IDs, 1K server-accounted output, 16 requests in flight, fixed MTP acceptance of 3 draft tokens

runtime.kv_pool: --mem-fraction-static 0.95 so that sixteen 64K-context requests fit (full-attention KV pool 1,442,464 tokens)

ab-20260718-64k-bs16.controlled: same host, running container, immutable image, model, benchmark command, TP8 topology, KV-pool setting, server flags and transition rule; two fresh-service repetitions per arm, run back-to-back
ab-20260718-64k-bs16.metric: steady-state scheduler generation throughput (tok/s) at batch 16; the first full-batch sample of each run is a transition sample and is excluded
